mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE declines > 0.3pp in 1 month, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, triggering positive equity returns as corporate revenue visibility improves over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both rise, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 0.5% monthly is followed by positive S&P 500 returns when unemployment rate declines (UNRATE) exceed 0.2 percentage points over three months, indicating synchronized manufacturing and labor recovery.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 3 months, INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly is followed by negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers equity risk-off behavior as central banks tighten policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 100k persons consistently supports consumer spending and corporate profit visibility, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A dovish monetary policy stance (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1% in 3 months combined with CPIAUCSL annual inflation < 2.0%) reduces real rates and supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate < 2.0%
failure_condition: In dovish policy environments (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL annual inflation < 2.0%), SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1.4 million units signal strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as economic momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1.4 million, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.
